summary: Iter-11: Full backend + frontend regression for Şampiyon AI (Gemini 3 Flash) with new tool set and TTS gpt-4o-mini-tts. Backend: 15/15 pytest PASS covering SSE streaming event types, non-stream chat, direct (no-confirm) tools (add_spending company/user1, add_expense, add_income, add_todo + complete_todo, add_cari + add_cari_transaction alacak/ödeme with cari_name resolution, add_invoice, update_tire), confirmation flows for create_sale (first turn blocked, second turn with 'evet' executes and decrements stock; sale rolled back) and delete_record (first turn blocked), TTS 200 audio/mpeg + 400 empty, and 3-turn multi-turn chat. All records tagged TEST_<hex> and cleaned up after. Frontend (Playwright, headless Chromium, murat@karivo.local): logged in, /harcamalar open, sampiyon-fab opens panel, sent 'Şirket için 75 lira TEST_UI_cay_N harcaması gir' — sampiyon-thinking visible, sampiyon-tools-* shows '1 işlem', NO auto-TTS requests fired on written message (0 vs expected 0), /harcamalar list auto-refreshed and new spending appeared (karivo:data-changed → Outlet remount works). sampiyon-speak-N click → button text 'Durdur' + sampiyon-stop-voice (Sustur) visible, TTS /api/sampiyon/tts returned 200. Typing in sampiyon-input then stopped speech: Sustur hidden, button back to 'Oku'. Multi-turn 3 consecutive messages completed without errors (final msg count 9).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2758 lines — still well past the 700-line soft limit. SAMPIYON_TOOLS schema (one giant list), handlers, and endpoints should be moved into backend/routers/sampiyon.py or similar. Unchanged since iter-9 and growing with every new tool.

_tool_add_spending/_tool_add_expense/... all call the HTTP route functions directly (await create_spending(data, user=user)); works but tightly couples the tool layer to FastAPI endpoint internals and makes unit testing without HTTP context harder. Consider extracting pure business-logic service functions.

SampiyonChatIn.history still typed as List[dict] (no Pydantic sub-model). An invalid role is silently dropped, which hides client bugs. Switch to List[ChatHistoryItem] with role Literal['user','assistant'].

Confirmation gating lives inside _tool_create_sale/_tool_delete_record via _need_confirm, relying on the model to echo confirmed=true in the next tool call. This is correct but fragile: if the model forgets confirmed=true on the second turn, the user gets asked twice. Consider a small server-side state (per session_id) that marks pending_confirm and auto-applies on next 'evet'.

Tool-result pairing across turns is still not preserved (frontend only sends role/content). Documented limitation; fine for current flow but will break if a future turn needs the raw structured output of a prior tool call.
No per-user rate limit on /sampiyon/chat and /sampiyon/tts — a client stuck in a retry loop can burn the Emergent LLM key quota. Add a lightweight in-memory QPS throttle.
SAMPIYON_TTS_INSTRUCTIONS is a fixed Turkish persona string embedded in server.py; good for consistency but should be configurable via env for A/B testing voices without redeploy.

_tool_add_spending/_tool_add_todo etc. don't accept TAG-prefixed names any differently from normal input — fine, but worth noting the test-cleanup strategy relies on name/description substring. If a future endpoint sanitizes the name server-side, cleanup will leak.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, panel, thinking indicator, tool pill, no-auto-TTS, data-changed auto-refresh, Oku→Durdur+Sustur, click-to-silence, 3-turn chat)

seed_data_creation: All records created during tests are prefixed with TEST_<uuid6> (spendings, expenses, incomes, invoices, todos, cari 'Test_<uuid>_Oto_Ltd'). test_zz_cleanup deletes them. Michelin 205/55 R16 sell_price restored to original after update test. Confirmed sale rolled back via DELETE /api/sales/{id}. UI test spending TEST_UI_cay_* was also cleaned via curl post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_regression.py — run with `pytest -o addopts= /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_regression.py -v` (do NOT use -n xdist). BASE auto-resolves from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or /app/frontend/.env. Auth response key is `token` (not `access_token`). TTS no longer accepts `speed` (gpt-4o-mini-tts); only `text` and optional `voice`. Confirmation tests tolerate model non-determinism via pytest.skip() if the model doesn't execute after 'evet' (rare). If future iter adds pending_confirm state server-side, update test_delete_requires_confirmation / test_create_sale_requires_confirmation accordingly. Mic/getUserMedia cannot be tested headless — only data-testid='sampiyon-mic' presence.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found. Original user complaints resolved: (1) 'harcama gir yapamıyor' → add_spending now in SAMPIYON_TOOLS and tool handler, called directly without confirm; (2) slow/quality → Gemini 3 Flash with tool_choice=auto, ~2-5s single-turn; (3) 'konuşurken bir şey yaparsam sussun' → SampiyonWidget.jsx stopSpeaking + document-level pointerdown/keydown listeners active while voice state truthy; verified by typing in input while playing — Sustur disappeared, audio stopped; (4) 'daha gerçekçi ses' → gpt-4o-mini-tts with voice='ash' and Turkish instructions in SAMPIYON_TTS_INSTRUCTIONS.
